title: Louisiana Starlink adoption hold: a comparable LEO schema exists but the 10,635-location cohort has no result
publisher: Louisiana Office of Broadband Development and Connectivity
summary: Montana defines a privacy-safe LEO reporting structure, but Louisiana's 10,635 planned Starlink locations still lack public activation, subscriber, test, retention, price, complaint, remediation, or accepted-closeout results. Denominator: The exact 10,635-location Louisiana agreement cohort reconciled to eligible, activated, installed, subscribed, tested, retained, complained, remediated, and accepted states.
key_findings: Evidence stage: Observed adoption outcome hold.

Finding: Montana defines a privacy-safe LEO reporting structure, but Louisiana's 10,635 planned Starlink locations still lack public activation, subscriber, test, retention, price, complaint, remediation, or accepted-closeout results.
Denominator: The exact 10,635-location Louisiana agreement cohort reconciled to eligible, activated, installed, subscribed, tested, retained, complained, remediated, and accepted states.
Boundary: Montana's reporting contract does not govern or measure Louisiana's award.
Boundary: Availability targets are not activation or adoption.
Boundary: No stable public subscriber or retention denominator is available.
Next action: Reopen after activated locations and privacy-safe denominators, subscribers, tests, retention, price, complaints, remediation, and closeout are public.
